title: poll.call
description: server → host and clients. FLIGHT calls one console. The called player's phone shows GO / NO-GO buttons; the host shows who is being called. The next call follows as soon as the answer arrives or the window ends. Disconnected players are not called; they are recorded as NO_ANSWER.

total.description: Number of calls in this poll.

roles.description: Roles from `order` that this player answers for.

endsAtMs.description: Server clock when the answer window ends.

PlayerId.description: Player identifier, unique within a room and never reused: "p" followed by a positive integer (p1, p2, …).

PollId.description: GO/NO-GO poll identifier chosen by the host; unique within the room.

RoleId.description: Mission Control role (§3.3), in canonical order.

TimeMs.description: Absolute time on the server clock: integer milliseconds since the Unix epoch. Every `…AtMs` field in the protocol uses the server clock (see Clock).
